description: This file is a React component page for displaying quiz history, utilizing Next.js features for server-side rendering and routing. It fetches quiz configuration data based on URL parameters and conditionally renders content depending on whether the quiz exists.

methods.name: QuizHistoryPage
methods.description: Asynchronous React component that retrieves quiz ID from URL parameters, fetches quiz configuration, and renders the quiz history or a 'not found' message.
